cases.description: The loan chart declared to accept loan.renew, copy.returned and loan.archived. The host checks the declaration against the chart's event vocabulary before it runs the case: loan.archived is unreachable, because no transition in the chart listens for it, and the descriptors the chart listens for that the declaration omits are undeclared, in document order. The chart then initializes into on_loan and hands the host its two loan timers.
cases.source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="predicator" initial="active">
    <datamodel>
        <data id="renewals" expr="0"/>
        <data id="max_renewals" expr="2"/>
        <data id="holds_pending" expr="false"/>
        <data id="patron_standing" expr="'good'"/>
        <data id="copy_id" expr="'c-1'"/>
    </datamodel>

    <state id="active" initial="on_loan">
        <history id="h" type="shallow">
            <transition target="on_loan"/>
        </history>

        <state id="on_loan">
            <onentry>
                <send type="library:timer" target="loan" event="loan.due" id="due" delay="21d"/>
                <send type="library:timer" target="loan" event="loan.due_soon" id="due_soon" delay="18d"/>
            </onentry>
            <transition event="loan.renew" target="on_loan" type="external" cond="renewals < max_renewals and not holds_pending and patron_standing == 'good'">
                <cancel sendid="due"/>
                <cancel sendid="due_soon"/>
                <assign location="renewals" expr="renewals + 1"/>
            </transition>
            <transition event="loan.due_soon" target="due_soon"/>
            <transition event="loan.due" target="overdue"/>
        </state>

        <state id="due_soon">
            <transition event="loan.due" target="overdue"/>
        </state>

        <state id="overdue">
            <onentry>
                <send type="library:timer" target="loan" event="loan.lost" id="lost" delay="28d"/>
            </onentry>
            <transition event="loan.lost" target="lost"/>
        </state>

        <transition event="copy.returned" target="returned"/>
        <transition event="copy.disputed" target="held_for_review"/>
    </state>

    <state id="held_for_review">
        <transition event="dispute.resolved" target="h"/>
    </state>

    <final id="returned">
        <onentry>
            <send type="library:route" target="hold_queue" event="copy.available">
                <param name="copy_id" expr="copy_id"/>
            </send>
        </onentry>
    </final>

    <final id="lost"/>
</scxml>

cases.description: The hold_queue chart diffed to an edit that declares one more datamodel key, branch_id, with the value b-1. Every state and transition of the old chart corresponds to one of the new, so the pair is compatible, and the addition is reported.

<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="predicator" initial="idle">
    <datamodel>
        <data id="copy_id" expr="'c-1'"/>
        <data id="pending" expr="0"/>
    </datamodel>

    <state id="idle">
        <transition event="hold.placed">
            <assign location="pending" expr="pending + 1"/>
        </transition>
        <transition event="copy.available" cond="pending > 0" target="awaiting_pickup"/>
        <transition event="copy.available" target="idle"/>
    </state>

    <state id="awaiting_pickup">
        <onentry>
            <send type="library:timer" target="hold_queue" event="pickup.expired" id="pickup" delay="7d"/>

        <onexit>
            <cancel sendid="pickup"/>
        </onexit>
        <transition event="hold.placed">
            <assign location="pending" expr="pending + 1"/>
        </transition>
        <transition event="pickup.expired" cond="pending > 1" target="awaiting_pickup">
            <assign location="pending" expr="pending - 1"/>
        </transition>
        <transition event="pickup.expired" target="idle">
            <assign location="pending" expr="pending - 1"/>
        </transition>
        <transition event="copy.collected" target="idle">
            <assign location="pending" expr="pending - 1"/>
        </transition>
    </state>
</scxml>

cases.description: The hold_queue chart with idle and awaiting_pickup inside a compound state open, whose own copy.disputed transition moves the copy to held_for_review. p-1's hold waits in awaiting_pickup while the edit adds a pending > 0 condition to open's copy.disputed transition and changes nothing inside awaiting_pickup. open is an ancestor of the active state, so it is in the configuration and its transition is selectable from there: the predicate answers false. cases.description: A dispute takes the loan out of active and its resolution puts it back through the shallow history, which restores due_soon rather than the initial on_loan; due_soon has no entry action, so the run's only sends are the two the checkout made.
cases.source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="predicator" initial="active">
    <datamodel>
        <data id="renewals" expr="0"/>
        <data id="max_renewals" expr="2"/>
        <data id="holds_pending" expr="false"/>
        <data id="patron_standing" expr="'good'"/>
        <data id="copy_id" expr="'c-1'"/>
    </datamodel>

    <state id="active" initial="on_loan">
        <history id="h" type="shallow">
            <transition target="on_loan"/>
        </history>

        <state id="on_loan">
            <onentry>
                <send type="library:timer" target="loan" event="loan.due" id="due" delay="21d"/>
                <send type="library:timer" target="loan" event="loan.due_soon" id="due_soon" delay="18d"/>
            </onentry>
            <transition event="loan.renew" target="on_loan" type="external" cond="renewals < max_renewals and not holds_pending and patron_standing == 'good'">
                <cancel sendid="due"/>
                <cancel sendid="due_soon"/>
                <assign location="renewals" expr="renewals + 1"/>
            </transition>
            <transition event="loan.due_soon" target="due_soon"/>
            <transition event="loan.due" target="overdue"/>
        </state>

        <state id="due_soon">
            <transition event="loan.due" target="overdue"/>
        </state>

        <state id="overdue">
            <onentry>
                <send type="library:timer" target="loan" event="loan.lost" id="lost" delay="28d"/>
            </onentry>
            <transition event="loan.lost" target="lost"/>
        </state>

        <transition event="copy.returned" target="returned"/>
        <transition event="copy.disputed" target="held_for_review"/>
    </state>

    <state id="held_for_review">
        <transition event="dispute.resolved" target="h"/>
    </state>

    <final id="returned">
        <onentry>
            <send type="library:route" target="hold_queue" event="copy.available">
                <param name="copy_id" expr="copy_id"/>
            </send>
        </onentry>
    </final>

    <final id="lost"/>
</scxml>

        <history id="h" type="shallow">
            <transition target="on_loan"/>
        </history>

        <state id="on_loan">
            <onentry>
                <send type="library:timer" target="loan" event="loan.due" id="due" delay="21d"/>
                <send type="library:timer" target="loan" event="loan.due_soon" id="due_soon" delay="18d"/>
            </onentry>
            <transition event="loan.renew" target="on_loan" type="external" cond="renewals < max_renewals and not holds_pending and patron_standing == 'good'">

                <cancel sendid="due_soon"/>
                <assign location="renewals" expr="renewals + 1"/>

            <transition event="loan.due_soon" target="due_soon"/>
            <transition event="loan.due" target="overdue"/>
        </state>

        <state id="due_soon">
            <transition event="loan.due" target="overdue"/>
        </state>

        <state id="overdue">
            <onentry>

            <transition event="loan.lost" target="lost"/>
        </state>

        <transition event="copy.returned" target="returned"/>
        <transition event="copy.disputed" target="held_for_review"/>
    </state>

    <state id="held_for_review">
        <transition event="dispute.resolved" target="h"/>
    </state>

    <final id="returned">
        <onentry>
            <send type="library:route" target="hold_queue" event="copy.available">
                <param name="copy_id" expr="copy_id"/>
            </send>
        </onentry>
    </final>

    <final id="lost"/>
</scxml>

cases.description: Patron p-1 is in good standing and owes nothing, so the desk's guard In('good') and not In('owed') is true and a checkout request is answered checkout_allowed; the answer waits in the desk region beside the unchanged good and none.
cases.source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="predicator" initial="patron">
    <datamodel>
        <data id="patron_id" expr="'p-1'"/>
    </datamodel>

    <parallel id="patron">
        <state id="standing" initial="good">
            <state id="good">
                <transition event="patron.blocked" target="blocked"/>
            </state>
            <state id="blocked">
                <transition event="patron.reinstated" target="good"/>
            </state>
        </state>

        <state id="fines" initial="none">
            <state id="none">
                <transition event="fine.assessed" target="owed"/>
            </state>
            <state id="owed">
                <transition event="fine.paid" target="none"/>
            </state>
        </state>

        <state id="desk" initial="waiting">
            <transition event="loan.requested" type="internal" cond="In('good') and not In('owed')" target="checkout_allowed"/>
            <transition event="loan.requested" type="internal" target="checkout_refused"/>

            <state id="waiting"/>
            <state id="checkout_allowed"/>
            <state id="checkout_refused"/>
        </state>
    </parallel>
</scxml>

cases.description: A delayed send of a registered type is handed to the host's processor with its delay, and the host never fires it, so the click, not the reminder, moves the chart; the cancel the chart then runs, naming the send, reaches the processor.
cases.source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="predicator" initial="awaiting_click">
    <state id="awaiting_click">
        <onentry>
            <send type="myapp:sink" target="reminders" event="impression.reminder" id="reminder" delay="10ms"/>
        </onentry>
        <transition event="impression.reminder" target="reminded"/>
        <transition event="click.recorded" target="clicked"/>
    </state>
    <state id="clicked">
        <onentry>
            <cancel sendid="reminder"/>
        </onentry>
    </state>
    <state id="reminded"/>
</scxml>

cases.description: A send of a registered type is handed to the host's processor with its target unread and its event built, and the chart moves on.
cases.source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="predicator" initial="awaiting_click">
    <datamodel>
        <data id="impression_id" expr="'imp-1'"/>
    </datamodel>
    <state id="awaiting_click">
        <transition event="click.recorded" target="joined">
            <send type="myapp:sink" target="joined_records" event="impression.joined" id="joined">
                <param name="impression_id" expr="impression_id"/>
            </send>
        </transition>
    </state>
    <state id="joined"/>
</scxml>

cases.description: A send of a registered type that the host reports it could not deliver comes back to the sender as error.communication carrying the send's sendid, and the chart takes the transition that names it.
cases.source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="predicator" initial="awaiting_copy">
    <state id="awaiting_copy">
        <transition event="copy.available" target="notifying"/>
    </state>
    <state id="notifying">
        <onentry>
            <send type="library:notice" target="patron" event="hold.ready" id="notice"/>
        </onentry>
        <transition event="error.communication" cond="_event.sendid == 'notice'" target="notice_failed"/>
        <transition event="error.communication" target="notice_failed_without_sendid"/>
    </state>
    <state id="notice_failed"/>
    <state id="notice_failed_without_sendid"/>
</scxml>

cases.description: A send whose type the host did not register is refused with error.execution, as an unsupported type is, and nothing is handed to the host.
cases.source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="predicator" initial="sending">
    <state id="sending">
        <onentry>
            <send type="myapp:unregistered" target="joined_records" event="impression.joined"/>
        </onentry>
        <transition event="error.execution" target="refused"/>
    </state>
    <state id="refused"/>
</scxml>

cases.description: A registered send type is an Event I/O Processor the session supports, so _ioprocessors carries an entry for it beside the SCXML processor's entry, and a type the host did not register has none.
cases.source:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="predicator" initial="checking">
    <state id="checking">
        <transition cond="_ioprocessors['myapp:sink'] !== undefined and _ioprocessors['http://www.w3.org/TR/scxml/#SCXMLEventProcessor'].location !== undefined and _ioprocessors['myapp:unregistered'] === undefined" target="listed"/>
        <transition target="unlisted"/>
    </state>
    <state id="listed"/>
    <state id="unlisted"/>
</scxml>
